netchb.message: This application never submits to NetCHB or CBP. Acceptance is not checked and is not implied.

findings.title: Invoice line amount differs from quantity × unit price
findings.description: Invoice line 1 (BP-T101): printed amount 6480.00 but 2400 x 2.85 = 6840.00 (difference 360.00). The printed amount is kept unchanged in the entered value; the difference is only a SUGGESTED correction until a broker approves it. Supporting evidence in the same invoice: the invoice's own FOB total (23235.00) equals the sum of quantity x price (23235.00) and not the sum of printed line amounts (22875.00). Alternative reading: a unit price of 2.7 would reproduce the printed amount, but the invoice's totals do not support that. Confirm against the payment record or ask the shipper.

findings.title: FOB total needs reconciliation
findings.description: Sum of printed line amounts (22875.00) differs from the invoice's printed FOB total (23235.00); the sum of quantity x price is 23235.00.

findings.title: Quantity differs between invoice and packing list
findings.description: BP-H205: invoice 1200 vs packing list 1176 (difference 24).

findings.title: Possible explanation for the quantity difference
findings.description: The 24-piece difference equals the free-of-charge sample quantity (24). Possible explanation: the invoice counted samples in this style. This is a hypothesis; confirm with the shipper.

findings.title: Gross weight differs between documents
findings.description: Gross weight: packing list 1888 kg vs B/L 1930 kg (difference 42 kg). The B/L figure is used; confirm.

findings.title: Container number was corrected by hand on the B/L
findings.description: The B/L printed container number OPLU1041726 (check digit INVALID) but it is corrected by hand to OPLU1041723 (check digit valid). The printed number is struck through and a handwritten OPLU1041723 is written beside it. The corrected number is used; confirm it with the carrier before filing.

findings.title: Mixed countries of origin
findings.description: Several countries of origin on one invoice (VN, BD). Each line carries its own origin and manufacturer; check the invoice's blanket origin declaration and the "Made in" carton marks.

findings.title: Buyer-supplied fabric may be an assist
findings.description: Line 4 (W-B220): buyer-supplied material worth 4180.00 is stated only in an invoice note, not in the invoice amount. It is kept separate and excluded from the entered value until a broker approves it (assists: 19 U.S.C. 1401a(h)(1)(A); amount and added costs need confirmation).

findings.title: Free-of-charge samples need valuation review
findings.description: Line 5 (BP-P118S) is free of charge; entered at the stated customs value 24. Sample treatment (for example HTSUS 9811.00.60 when marked or valued at $1 or less) needs broker review.

findings.title: Invoice number changed for NetCHB
findings.description: Invoice number "HLAS/BP/26-0912" contains characters NetCHB does not accept (allowed: letters, digits, hyphen, max 17). Submitted as "HLAS-BP-26-0912"; keep a mapping.

findings.title: Extraction note
findings.description: Extraction note: The B/L container number was corrected by hand; verify the final digits against the carrier's record.

findings.title: Total pieces differ between documents
findings.description: Total pieces: packing list 5100 vs invoice 5124.

findings.title: Tariff classification remains incomplete
findings.description: 5 lines have no approved 10-digit HTSUS number: BP-T101, BP-H205, BP-C330, W-B220, BP-P118S. The documents carry only 6-digit HS codes; nothing is inferred. A broker must supply the classifications.

findings.title: Suggested value changes await broker approval
findings.description: 2 suggested components are excluded from the entered value (22899.00 USD). Approving all would make it 27439.00 USD.
